executive_summary: Maven test compilation failed with 100 errors across 3 test classes. Primary issues: (1) Type mismatch between Priority and TaskPriority enums, (2) Incorrect type conversions from long to UUID/String, (3) Service method signature mismatches requiring additional userId parameter. All errors stem from API contract changes not reflected in test code.

errors.message: Priority enum cannot be converted to TaskPriority (occurs 13 times)
errors.root_cause: Test code uses Priority enum but the application expects TaskPriority enum. This indicates an enum rename or package change that was not propagated to tests.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all test imports and usages from 'com.myproject.models.dtos.Priority' to 'com.myproject.models.dtos.TaskPriority'. Use IDE refactoring to replace all 13 occurrences.

errors.message: long cannot be converted to UUID (occurs 10 times)
errors.root_cause: Task IDs changed from long to UUID type but test code still uses long primitives for task identification.
errors.fix_recommendation: Replace all long task ID declarations with UUID.randomUUID() or UUID.fromString() calls. Update test data setup to use UUID type instead of long.

errors.message: createTask method signature mismatch - missing userId parameter (occurs 12 times)
errors.root_cause: TaskService.createTask() now requires userId as first parameter but tests call it with only TaskCreateRequest.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add userId parameter to all createTask() calls: change 'taskService.createTask(request)' to 'taskService.createTask("user123", request)'. Extract userId as test constant.

errors.message: getUserTasks method signature mismatch - missing sortBy parameter (occurs 9 times)
errors.root_cause: TaskService.getUserTasks() now requires 4 parameters (userId, page, size, sortBy) but tests provide only 3 (userId as long, page, size).
errors.fix_recommendation: Add sortBy parameter and fix userId type: change 'getUserTasks(1L, 0, 10)' to 'getUserTasks("user1", 0, 10, "createdAt")'. Convert userId from long to String.

errors.message: getTaskById method signature mismatch - missing userId parameter (occurs 4 times)
errors.root_cause: TaskService.getTaskById() now requires both taskId (UUID) and userId (String) but tests call with only long taskId.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update method calls: change 'getTaskById(1L)' to 'getTaskById(UUID.fromString("..."), "user123")'. Fix both parameter count and types.

errors.root_cause: GlobalExceptionHandler no longer has handleValidationErrors() method - likely renamed or removed during refactoring.
errors.fix_recommendation: Check GlobalExceptionHandler for the correct validation error handling method name. Update test to call the correct method or remove tests if validation handling was removed.

errors.message: Multiple type mismatches - long to String, Priority to TaskPriority (occurs 15 times)
errors.root_cause: InMemoryTaskDataStore tests use outdated types: long for userId (now String), Priority enum (now TaskPriority), and long for taskId (now UUID).
errors.fix_recommendation: Refactor all InMemoryTaskDataStore test data: (1) Change userId from long to String, (2) Replace Priority with TaskPriority, (3) Replace long taskId with UUID.

errors.message: findAll() and existsById() methods not found (occurs 3 times)
errors.root_cause: InMemoryTaskDataStore API changed - findAll() and existsById() methods no longer exist or were renamed.
errors.fix_recommendation: Review InMemoryTaskDataStore interface for replacement methods. Update tests to use correct query methods or remove tests if functionality was removed.
